title: Observation Alert Record
$comment: Repository-authoritative implementation schema (ticket #52, SPEC-304 section 14). Deliberately differs from the read-only spec-package draft schemas/alert-record.schema.json (G2, brief section 8): (a) the draft state enum lacks 'inactive' and misplaces 'suppressed' INSIDE the state enum — per SPEC-304 section 5 and the approved seam ruling #12 the lifecycle is inactive/pending/firing/resolving/resolved and suppression is NOT a migration state: it is a modifier on the record carried by the 'suppression' metadata object (suppressed records stay query-visible; unsuppression restores the prior lifecycle state because the state never moved); (b) time requires clock_epoch + semantics — record-level timepoints carry explicit semantics per SPEC-300 section 6 (the ENVELOPE timepoint intentionally does not, SPEC-301 section 6; ruling #12 extends the record-level discipline to record schemas); (c) rule_version is required (the frozen alerts table column is NOT NULL, SPEC-502 section 4 / ticket #23 R8); (d) evidence_refs is bounded (maxItems 64, item maxLength 256) as the SPEC-304 section 13 alert-storm guard — refs are opaque resolvable tokens (metric:<name>:bucket-<start_ns> / journal:<seq>), never payload text. The spec-package draft is NOT edited in place (docs/spec README rule 2); the divergences are declared in the ticket #52 implementation report.
